# apple_devices (Data Source)

Lists the registered devices that match every given filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every enabled iOS device, for a development profile.
data "apple_devices" "ios" {
  platforms = ["IOS"]
  statuses  = ["ENABLED"]
}

resource "apple_profile" "development" {
  name            = "Example Development"
  profile_type    = "IOS_APP_DEVELOPMENT"
  bundle_id       = apple_bundle_id.app.id
  certificate_ids = [apple_certificate.development.id]
  device_ids      = data.apple_devices.ios.devices[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `names` (Set of String) Names to match.
- `platforms` (Set of String) Platforms to match. Values: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `UNIVERSAL`.
- `statuses` (Set of String) Statuses to match. Values: `ENABLED`, `DISABLED`.
- `udids` (Set of String) UDIDs to match.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) The matching devices, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `added_date` (String) When the device was registered, in RFC 3339 format.
- `device_class` (String) Class of the device, e.g. `IPHONE`.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the device.
- `model` (String) Model of the device.
- `name` (String) Name of the device.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the device.
- `status` (String) Status: `ENABLED` or `DISABLED`.
- `udid` (String) UDID of the device.
